_schema: Settings for python -m tmaze.tools.dlc_offline (docs/decisions/0227, 0229). pipeline must end in _iter<N> matching the DLC project's iteration, so a retrained model writes a new pipeline folder instead of mixing results. python is the env that has DeepLabCut; extra_site_packages is put first on its path (the GPU torch build). keep_raw keeps DeepLabCut's per-frame pickles (~200 MB per video) under raw/ so the track can be rebuilt without the GPU.
